description: Binds the React Proof / Operator Center panel to the Codex Proof / Operator Center milestone dashboard evidence (DETERMINEX_PROOF_OPERATOR_CENTER_MILESTONE_DASHBOARD_LOCK_001) read-only. Adds a read-only Tauri command get_proof_operator_center_milestone_dashboard_status, a Python loader at scripts/ide/proof_operator_center_milestone_dashboard_status.py, and a React component at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/ProofOperatorCenterMilestoneDashboard.tsx. The loader reads the most recent run_*.json under assurance/evidence/proof_operator_center_milestone_dashboard/ and returns PASSED only if (1) status == PROOF_OPERATOR_CENTER_MILESTONE_DASHBOARD_PASSED; (2) source_mutation_authorized / training_eligible / training_rows_written / approval_authority_granted / release_ready / proof_execution_authority_granted / release_deploy_workflow_created / artifact_import_authorized / benchmark_execution_authorized / programbench_execution_authorized are all NOT True (top-level or under authority_status); (3) broad_claims_granted is NOT True (top-level or under authority_status); (4) release_gate_status.release_ready is NOT True; (5) release_gate_status.columbia_house_tracker is in {pending, pending_not_built}; (6) scale_to_100_status.normalized_as_current_ct_lock is NOT True; (7) surface_statuses contains entries for all five rooms (Idea Lab, Repo Clinic, Maintenance Bay, Learning Studio, Proof / Operator Center) AND Proof / Operator Center's react_bound is NOT True inside the evidence (the binding only becomes true after this lock lands); (8) evidence_health.count_drift_status == EVIDENCE_COUNT_DRIFT_GUARD_PASSED AND append_only_ledger_chain_valid == True AND evidence_index_valid == True; (9) claim_boundary includes the 12 required scope statements; (10) no affirmative forbidden broad-claim phrase appears outside blocked_path_demo / claim_boundary / claim_boundary_status / surface_statuses / source_evidence_paths / source_audit_paths. If the evidence file is not present locally, returns AWAITING_EVIDENCE; if status != PASSED returns BLOCKED_MALFORMED; the React component surfaces an 'Awaiting Codex reconciliation' or 'Binding blocked' banner accordingly. The component renders: five-room table (Idea Lab + Repo Clinic + Maintenance Bay + Learning Studio + Proof / Operator Center), authority status (source_mutation_authorized=false, approval_authority_granted=false, proof_execution_authority_granted=false, training_eligible=false, training_rows_written=false / 0, release_ready=false, broad_claims_granted=false), release gate status (Cathedral Index, Columbia House Tracker (pending, not built), public claims ledger, release repo scrub, fresh install / demo workflow, Windows-first support matrix), Scale-to-100 status (roadmap/audit input only, normalized_as_current_ct_lock=false, Windows-first matrix lock, corpus/training reconciliation lock, expansion queue, legacy/enterprise, audit doc path), evidence health (evidence_index_count, append-only ledger, count drift expected/actual, JSON parse status, evidence_ref, dashboard report path, machine-readable dashboard path), claim boundary list, forbidden claims list, blocked path summary list, roadmap items list, next rung, and 9 required captions ('Ready does NOT mean authorized.', 'Verified rooms do NOT mean universal support.', 'Proof Center displays authority; it does not grant authority.', 'Release ready remains false.', 'Training remains false.', 'Source mutation remains false.', 'Scale-to-100 is roadmap/audit input, not current C&T lock.', 'Columbia House is pending, not built.', 'Full Cathedral roadmap is not validated by this binding.'). It NEVER surfaces: all apps / any language / all platforms / all codebases / production-ready arbitrary app generation / fully autonomous maintenance / release_ready: true / training_eligible: true / approval_authority_granted: true / proof_execution_authority_granted: true / broad_claims_granted: true / Columbia House Tracker built / Columbia House Tracker verified / Scale-to-100 lock active / Full Cathedral roadmap validated / verified room means universal support.
purpose: Bind the verified Proof / Operator Center milestone dashboard evidence into the live React Proof / Operator Center panel as a non-authorizing, scope-disciplined view-model.
